jobAdDetails.title: Director of Sales Operations, North America
jobAdDetails.description:
We’re hiring a Director of Sales Operations - a high-impact leadership role at the heart of our Go-To-Market engine
Reporting to the CRO, you’ll build the structure, discipline, and deal governance that turns pipeline into predictable revenue at scale. This is a standout opportunity for a commercially sharp operator who can influence at the top table and drive execution across a complex, global sales organization.
 
Our ideal candidate is a senior commercial leader within the Go-To-Market organization, responsible for building and running the execution infrastructure that converts pipeline into predictable, scalable revenue.
This role owns global Sales Operations and Bid Management - bringing discipline, structure, and commercial rigor to how the company plans, forecasts and operates in the field. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy and execution.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
• 10+ years in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, or Deal Management in complex enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Proven track record at senior leadership level, partnering closely with CROs and senior Sales leaders to drive execution.
  • Deep fluency in enterprise sales motions, forecasting discipline, deal economics, and cross-functional commercial governance.
  • Strong executive presence and sound commercial judgment — able to influence senior stakeholders through data, structure, and credibility.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Sales Operations Leadership
  • Own the global Sales Operations function: sales planning, forecasting, pipeline management, territory and coverage design, and CRM discipline.
  • Define and enforce standards for pipeline hygiene, forecast methodology, and sales operating metrics across all regions.
  • Lead annual and quarterly planning cycles in close partnership with Sales leadership and Finance, translating strategy into executable field plans.
  • Deliver executive-ready visibility into performance, risks, and opportunities — with clear narratives that drive decision-making at the top.
Bid Management & Deal Governance
  • Own the global bid/no-bid and deal governance framework end-to-end.
  • Lead structured deal review forums for complex, non-standard, or high-value opportunities, ensuring alignment across Sales, Finance and Legal.
  • Establish and maintain approval thresholds, escalation paths, and decision rights for pricing, discounting, commercial terms, and exceptions.
  • Hold the balance between commercial rigor and sales agility — protecting EBITDAC without slowing momentum.
Sales Execution Cadence
  • Own the core operating rhythm: pipeline reviews, forecast calls, QBRs, and executive deal reviews.
  • Act as a thought partner to Sales leadership — diagnosing execution gaps, improving forecast accuracy, and building consistency across regions.
  • Proactively bring risks and corrective actions to the CRO before they become problems.
Incentives & Performance Management
  • Oversee the design, governance, and execution of sales incentive structures in partnership with Finance and HR.
  • Ensure incentive plans are strategy-aligned, operationally sound, and driving the right field behaviors.
  • Monitor sales productivity trends to inform adjustments to targets, coverage models, and operating structures.
Cross-Functional Leadership
  • Serve as the primary operational bridge between Sales and Finance, Legal, and RevOps on all matters related to sales execution and deal decisioning.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships across functions, ensuring alignment and shared accountability for commercial outcomes.
  • Represent Sales Operations and Bid Management in executive forums with authority and credibility.
Leadership & Team
  • Lead and develop a global Sales Operations and Bid Management team across regions.
  • Set clear priorities, accountabilities, and outcomes — fostering a culture of execution, rigor, and genuine partnership with the business.
  • Actively build bench strength and succession capability within the function.

jobAdDetails.title: Project Manager
jobAdDetails.description:
Start your career where innovation meets real impact!

Sapiens Accelerate is our global Early Careers Programme, designed for graduates with up to 18 months of experience, who are ready to learn, contribute, and shape the future of insurance. From day one, you'll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with experts across the business, build practical AI skills, and develop the capabilities needed to thrive in a global technology company. 

Role summary:
Manages the full lifecycle of assigned insurance platform implementation, upgrade, or migration engagements from scope definition through closure and lessons-learned documentation.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
(entry-level scope) 

  • Manage the full project lifecycle for assigned insurance platform implementation, upgrade, or migration engagements: scoping, planning, execution coordination, and closure.
  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation: charters, delivery roadmaps, risk registers, issue logs, milestone trackers, and stakeholder communication plans.
  • Facilitate steering committee governance: prepare status reports, manage meeting cadence, and maintain escalation paths for out-of-tolerance delivery issues.
  • Identify and manage delivery risks and dependencies, applying change control discipline and escalating portfolio-level conflicts to the Program Manager.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional workstream handoffs between Professional Services & Implementation, Customer Value Management, SaaS Support & Platform Governance, and customer stakeholders for complex accounts.

What this looks like at entry level 
Identifies practical opportunities to use AI and automation in day-to-day project management activities. This includes improving the efficiency and reliability of data consolidation, increasing the accuracy of governance reporting, and providing leadership with clearer information for decision-making. Explores ways to automate the tracking of project dependencies and risks, while ensuring that outputs remain accurate and subject to appropriate human review

jobAdDetails.title: Lead Product Manager - Platform
jobAdDetails.description:
Sapiens is a global leader in intelligent SaaS-based software solutions for the insurance industry, serving more than 600 insurers worldwide. We are transforming the insurance landscape through innovative technology, cloud-based platforms and AI-powered solutions that help insurers modernize operations and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

We are seeking a Lead Product Manager – Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care & Group to lead the strategic direction, development and commercial success of our US Life and Annuity portfolio, while expanding our capabilities across Long-Term Care (LTC) and Group Insurance.

This is a hands-on leadership position combining product strategy, market development and day-to-day product management. The successful candidate will work closely with Engineering, Delivery, Sales, Marketing and executive leadership to shape the product roadmap, drive innovation and position Sapiens as a leading technology partner for US insurance carriers.
jobAdDetails.requirements:
Required
  • 10+ years of experience within the US Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care and/or Group Insurance industries.
  • Deep domain expertise in at least two of the following areas: Life Insurance, Annuities, Long-Term Care or Group Insurance.
  • Proven experience in hands-on product management within an Agile software development environment.
  • Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Strong understanding of insurance products and processes, including policy administration, new business, underwriting, servicing, commissions, billing and claims.
  • Experience owning product portfolios and demonstrating measurable business impact through revenue growth, customer retention or competitive win rates.
  • Strong understanding of US insurance regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with executive leadership, customers and technical teams.

Preferred
  • Experience introducing AI, automation or intelligent capabilities into regulated insurance environments.
  • Exposure to cloud-based SaaS platforms and modernization of legacy insurance administration systems.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and integrations, including ACORD, DTCC, enrollment and billing feeds, and employer or benefits administration platforms.
  • Background in actuarial, underwriting or insurance operations.
  • Professional designations such as FLMI, LOMA or equivalent industry credentials.
  • Previous experience as a Product Manager or Business Analyst supporting insurance platform implementations.
jobAdDetails.responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy and multi-year roadmap across Life, Annuities, Long-Term Care and Group Insurance.
  • Identify market opportunities, emerging industry trends and customer requirements to guide product investment and innovation.
  • Develop business cases and prioritize product initiatives based on commercial value, customer needs, regulatory requirements and platform capabilities.
  • Drive the expansion of Sapiens' product offerings into LTC and Group Insurance markets.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to establish investment priorities and support overall portfolio growth.

Product Development & Execution
  • Lead hands-on product management activities within an Agile development environment.
  • Own and prioritize product backlogs, epics, user stories, acceptance criteria and product requirements.
  • Partner with Engineering, Domain Modelers and Solution Designers to translate business needs into scalable product solutions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews and product acceptance.
  • Prepare product documentation, smartbooks and functional specifications.
  • Work directly with Sapiens' CoreSuite platform, including product configuration, demonstrations and evaluation of platform capabilities.
  • Drive AI-enabled product innovation, leveraging automation and intelligent capabilities across underwriting, new business, policy administration, claims and servicing.

Market & Customer Engagement
  • Develop a deep understanding of the US Life, Annuity, LTC and Group Insurance markets, including customer needs, competitive positioning and emerging product trends.
  • Build strong relationships with insurance carriers, distributors, brokers and strategic partners.
  • Lead customer advisory discussions and engage with executive stakeholders to understand business priorities.
  • Translate customer feedback and market insights into actionable product enhancements and roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities, customer presentations, product demonstrations and RFP responses.

Regulatory & Industry Expertise
  • Monitor US insurance regulatory developments and ensure product capabilities remain aligned with applicable industry requirements.
  • Maintain knowledge of relevant NAIC regulations, state insurance requirements, annuity suitability standards and life insurance product regulations.
  • Understand regulatory considerations impacting LTC, including rate increases, claims handling and state partnership programs.
  • Support Group Insurance requirements, including ERISA, ACA, COBRA, portability and conversion.
  • Ensure regulatory changes are incorporated into product roadmaps and delivered effectively to customers.

Commercial & Business Leadership
  • Drive portfolio growth through new customer acquisition, existing customer expansion and improved competitive positioning.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to develop product positioning, messaging and go-to-market strategies.
  • Support pricing, packaging and commercial decisions in partnership with product and commercial leadership.
  • Monitor product performance, adoption, customer satisfaction and revenue contribution.
  • Identify opportunities to improve implementation efficiency, product quality and overall cost to serve.
jobAdDetails.benefits:
At Sapiens, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of insurance technology and contribute to the evolution of AI-powered, intelligent insurance platforms.
You'll work alongside talented professionals across Product, Engineering, Delivery and Commercial teams, with the opportunity to influence strategic product decisions, drive innovation and make a meaningful impact across the North American insurance market.

We offer an environment that values collaboration, professional development, innovation and continuous improvement.

Sapiens is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background and evaluate everyone on merit.
